events.title: Vandal king Huneric removes the Nicene bishops of his kingdom
events.description: After a meeting of Nicene and Arian bishops earlier that month, Huneric forcibly removed the Nicene bishops from office and banished some to Corsica. A few Nicenes who refused to become Arians were executed; his successor let the exiles return.
events.html: After a meeting of Nicene and Arian bishops earlier that month, Huneric forcibly removed the Nicene bishops from office and banished some to Corsica. A few Nicenes who refused to become Arians were executed; his successor let the exiles return.

events.title: The Scots defeat an English force at Roslin
events.description: During the First War of Scottish Independence, a Scottish force led by John Comyn and Sir Simon Fraser ambushed and defeated an English reconnaissance party under Lord John Segrave near the village of Roslin.
events.html: During the First War of Scottish Independence, a Scottish force led by John Comyn and Sir Simon Fraser ambushed and defeated an English reconnaissance party under Lord John Segrave near the village of Roslin.

events.title: Charles III of Naples dies after an attack at Buda
events.description: Charles III of Naples, known as Charles of Durazzo, who had seized the Hungarian throne in 1385, died of the wounds he had received in an attack at Buda. He had won Naples by overthrowing his cousin Joanna I.
events.html: Charles III of Naples, known as Charles of Durazzo, who had seized the Hungarian throne in 1385, died of the wounds he had received in an attack at Buda. He had won Naples by overthrowing his cousin Joanna I.

events.title: Imperial army captures Francis I at the Battle of Pavia
events.description: Charles V's troops routed the French outside Pavia, and King Francis I was taken prisoner. He was released in 1526 only after signing away claims in Italy and Burgundy.
events.html: Charles V's troops routed the French outside Pavia, and King Francis I was taken prisoner. He was released in 1526 only after signing away claims in Italy and Burgundy.

events.title: Pope Gregory XIII issues the bull reforming the calendar
events.description: The bull Inter gravissimas introduced the Gregorian calendar, dropping ten days that October to realign the calendar with the equinox. It is now the world's standard civil calendar.
events.html: The bull Inter gravissimas introduced the Gregorian calendar, dropping ten days that October to realign the calendar with the equinox. It is now the world's standard civil calendar.

events.title: Nader Shah defeats the Mughal army of Muhammad Shah at Karnal
events.description: Nader Shah's forces defeated the army of the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah within three hours near Karnal, 110 kilometres north of Delhi. The victory opened the way to the Iranian sack of Delhi and critically weakened the declining Mughal dynasty.
events.html: Nader Shah's forces defeated the army of the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah within three hours near Karnal, 110 kilometres north of Delhi. The victory opened the way to the Iranian sack of Delhi and critically weakened the declining Mughal dynasty.

events.title: Marbury v. Madison establishes judicial review
events.description: Chief Justice John Marshall ruled that the Supreme Court could strike down acts of Congress that conflicted with the Constitution. The decision became central to American constitutional law.
events.html: Chief Justice John Marshall ruled that the Supreme Court could strike down acts of Congress that conflicted with the Constitution. The decision became central to American constitutional law.

events.title: USS Hornet sinks HMS Peacock off the Demerara River
events.description: In the War of 1812 the sloop of war USS Hornet fought the brig-sloop HMS Peacock off the mouth of the Demerara River in Guyana. After an exchange of broadsides Hornet raked Peacock and forced her to strike; she was so badly damaged that she sank soon after.

events.title: Plan of Iguala sets out Mexican independence
events.description: Agustín de Iturbide and Vicente Guerrero proclaimed a plan for an independent Mexican monarchy guaranteeing Catholicism and equality. Mexico's independence was declared that September.
events.html: Agustín de Iturbide and Vicente Guerrero proclaimed a plan for an independent Mexican monarchy guaranteeing Catholicism and equality. Mexico's independence was declared that September.

events.title: The Treaty of Yandabo ends the First Anglo-Burmese War
events.description: With a British army at Yandabo, 80 km from the capital Ava, the Burmese had to accept the British terms without discussion. The war left the British in control of Assam, Manipur, Arakan and Tenasserim, and Burma agreed to an indemnity of one million pounds.

events.title: Hitler presents the Nazi Party's 25-point programme
events.description: At the Hofbräuhaus in Munich, Hitler read out the programme of the German Workers' Party, which renamed itself the National Socialist German Workers' Party (NSDAP) around this time.
events.html: At the Hofbräuhaus in Munich, Hitler read out the programme of the German Workers' Party, which renamed itself the National Socialist German Workers' Party (NSDAP) around this time.

events.title: Juan Perón elected President of Argentina
events.description: The former labour minister won the presidency with strong support from trade unions. With his wife Eva, he built the populist Peronist movement that still shapes Argentine politics.
events.html: The former labour minister won the presidency with strong support from trade unions. With his wife Eva, he built the populist Peronist movement that still shapes Argentine politics.

song: Kenyan popular music; East African tourist venues
A cheerful Kenyan pop song from 1982, made of everyday Swahili greetings and loved by visitors to East Africa.
